title: Pin photodiode lit by an FDFD wave: Beer-Lambert generation and responsivity (analytic)
description:
The lateral p+ / i / n+ silicon diode of the silicon_pn_photodiode template (4 x 0.2 um, 10 nm cells, contacts on the outer 0.1 um), reverse-biased by V_reverse = 3 V so the 2 um absorber (x = 1..3 um, background donors 1e21) is fully depleted. A 1.55 um plane-wave mode (em_fdfd_ez, y periodic, CPML along x) of power P_in per m of depth is launched toward +x in the p+ region. The absorber carries an artificial band-to-band loss sigma_e = c eps0 n alpha_nom (library silicon is lossless at 1.55 um); em_semiconductor_generation turns the absorbed power into pairs, G = q_abs lambda / (h c) (photon energy from the FDFD wavelength).
Analytic: absorbed fraction A = (1 - R) (1 - exp(-a d)), a = 2 k0 kappa / sqrt(1 - (n k0 dx / 2)^2) (kappa = Im sqrt(eps), with the grid-dispersion factor), R the front-face reflection (~3e-4); G(x) = (lambda / h c) a (1 - R) (P_in / Ly) exp(-a (x - x_a0)) in the absorber; every pair is collected (transit ~1e-11 s against the 1 us lifetime), so I_photo = q lambda / (h c) A P_in and the responsivity is 1.25 A/W times A.
Derived values tab: P_front / P_trans (flux in front of / behind the absorber; P_trans = P_in (1 - R)^2 (1 + kappa^2 / n^2) exp(-a d), the exit factor |N|^2 / n^2 of a wave leaving an absorbing medium, 5e-3 at 2 per um), P_absorbed and G_total (integral of the coupled generation) against the Fresnel / Beer-Lambert forms (~1e-3; the neglected back-face reflection is ~1e-5 of the absorbed power), I_photo and responsivity from the cathode table (~1e-3), I_anode = -I_photo (Kirchhoff) and R_total (integral of the net recombination: photocarrier recombination minus thermal generation in the depleted absorber, |R_total| ~1e-6 of G_total).
Sweep tab: responsivity and P_absorbed versus alpha_nom (0.25..2 per um) with their dashed curves.
Line profile tab (last sweep value, alpha_nom = 2 per um): G_profile (semiconductor.generation) and q_profile (em.absorbed_power), the exponential decay over the absorber; a few % standing-wave ripple (of the local value, ~1e-3 of the front value) next to its back face. Field tab: em.ez_abs, em.absorbed_power, semiconductor.generation, V, N, P.

parameters.name: V_reverse
parameters.description: reverse bias of the cathode in V (anode at 0 V)

parameters.name: alpha_nom
parameters.description: nominal power absorption coefficient of the absorber in 1/m (the sweep runs 0.25..2 per um)

parameters.name: P_in
parameters.description: mode source power in W per m of depth (2D; low injection)

parameters.name: lambda0
parameters.description: vacuum wavelength of the FDFD solve (also the photon wavelength)

parameters.name: k_vac
parameters.description: vacuum wavenumber k0 in 1/m

parameters.name: n_si
parameters.description: silicon index at 1.55 um (eps_r = n_si^2 = 12.08, the library value)

parameters.name: q_e
parameters.description: elementary charge in C

parameters.name: h_planck
parameters.description: Planck constant in J s

parameters.name: Lx
parameters.description: diode length along x

parameters.name: Ly
parameters.description: period along y (periodic EM faces, insulating semiconductor faces)

parameters.name: dx_cell
parameters.description: uniform cell size

parameters.name: x_a0
parameters.description: absorber front face (a cell face)

parameters.name: x_a1
parameters.description: absorber back face

parameters.name: d_abs
parameters.description: absorber length in m

parameters.name: x_src
parameters.description: mode source line (cell 50 centre, p+ region), launching toward +x

parameters.name: x_flux_up
parameters.description: flux monitor in front of the absorber (cell 80 centre)

parameters.name: x_flux_down
parameters.description: flux monitor behind the absorber (cell 350 centre)

parameters.name: sigma_abs
parameters.description: optical conductivity sigma_e of the absorber in S/m (9.2e3 at 1 per um)

parameters.name: eps_imag
parameters.description: Im eps = sigma / (omega eps0) of the absorber

parameters.name: eps_abs
parameters.description: |eps| of the absorber

parameters.name: kappa
parameters.description: extinction coefficient Im sqrt(eps) of the absorber

parameters.name: n_re
parameters.description: Re sqrt(eps) of the absorber

parameters.name: ksi0
parameters.description: half-cell phase n k0 dx / 2 (grid-dispersion factor below)

parameters.name: a_att
parameters.description: power attenuation coefficient of the discrete wave in 1/m

parameters.name: R_front
parameters.description: power reflection of the absorber front face

parameters.name: exit_factor
parameters.description: back-face power transmission over (1 - R) for a wave leaving an absorbing medium: |N|^2 / n_re^2

parameters.name: A_ref
parameters.description: absorbed fraction (back-face reflection neglected)

parameters.name: P_abs_ref
parameters.description: analytic absorbed power in W/m

parameters.name: photons_per_J
parameters.description: photons per joule at lambda0 (7.80e18)

parameters.name: q_front
parameters.description: absorbed power density at the absorber front in W/m^3

parameters.name: G_front
parameters.description: generation rate at the absorber front in 1/(m^3 s)

parameters.name: I_ref
parameters.description: analytic photocurrent in A/m (full collection)

parameters.name: resp_ref
parameters.description: analytic responsivity in A/W
